'''June 2001 Geneva tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Geneva, Illinois on 10 June 2001. Ulaire Fred (DeckTech handle) won it. It is known from . "Ulaire Fred" .'s tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2435">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-10-elvis-at-geneva-il-08-10d2435/ elvis-at-geneva-il-08-10], DeckTech (. "Ulaire Fred" ., 10 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-10-elvis-at-geneva-il-08-10d2435/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Geneva, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' Ulaire Fred (DeckTech handle)
